evaluation_contract: Structural and negative scenario assertions require fresh blind prediction; no target workflow execution is implied.

evals.name: bounded-lookup
evals.prompt: Find saved evidence for this question but the semantic service is paused.
evals.expected_output: Report the projection gap, read authorized canonical files if available, and preserve source qualifications.

assertions.name: bounded-lookup-1
assertions.check: Does not start services or rebuild embeddings for an ordinary lookup.

assertions.name: bounded-lookup-2
assertions.check: Separates an authored SUPPORTED claim from independently verified evidence.

evals.name: pending-save
evals.prompt: I requested new research; canonical save succeeded but indexing is pending.
evals.expected_output: Report canonical save separately and retry the identical capture only to resume pending indexing.

assertions.name: pending-save-1
assertions.check: Does not repeat the research merely to retry indexing.

assertions.name: pending-save-2
assertions.check: Does not claim indexed retrieval succeeded until read back.

evals.name: stale-revision
evals.prompt: Update an owned capture using an old manifest checksum.
evals.expected_output: Retain the expected_checksum ownership/revision guard and preserve earlier revisions.

assertions.name: stale-revision-1
assertions.check: Uses the current expected checksum guard.

assertions.name: stale-revision-2
assertions.check: Does not overwrite unowned canonical packs or discard history.
